Meet Claire Vance

Based in Austin, Texas, Claire Vance founded Dream Home Decor (dreamhomedecor.net) after spending over a decade styling residential living spaces, historic bungalows, and modern urban apartments across Texas, California, and the Pacific Northwest.

Her mission is simple: translate high-end architectural and interior design principles—spatial proportion, warm neutral layering, organic wood tones, and multi-point lighting—into clear, practical guides that any homeowner or renter can apply on a realistic budget.

1. Our Story & Design Philosophy

Most home decor websites fall into one of two extremes: either unattainable multi-million-dollar architectural showpieces that feel cold and unlivable, or generic mass-market furniture checklists that lack character. We launched Dream Home Decor to bridge that gap.

Every room guide published on dreamhomedecor.net is built around what we call “Livable Architectural Warmth”—combining timeless foundational materials (white oak, walnut, unlacquered brass, natural linen, terracotta, and limewash plaster) with functional floor plans that work for real families, pets, and everyday routines.

2. Our 4-Step Editorial & Spatial Research Methodology

📐 1. Spatial Proportion & Clearance Math

We verify standard U.S. residential dimensions—such as 30–36 inch walkway clearances, 14–18 inch sofa-to-coffee-table reach, and proper 8×10 vs. 9×12 area rug anchoring—so every layout actually works in real rooms.

🎨 2. Daylight & Kelvin Lighting Testing

Paint colors and wood stains shift dramatically between north-facing daylight and 2700K warm evening lamps. We explain Light Reflectance Values (LRV) and warm undertones so you avoid muddy or sterile walls.

🧶 3. Tactile Material Pairing

A cozy room relies on contrast in texture. We pair smooth architectural surfaces (marble, drywall, glass) with nubby bouclé, washed Belgian linen, woven jute, and grained hardwoods.

💡 4. High/Low Budget Accessibility

You do not need custom millwork in every room. Our guides highlight where to invest (anchor sofas, lighting, solid wood tables) and where to save (throw pillows, Peel-and-Stick moulding, vintage vessels).

3. Meet Our Editorial & Styling Contributors

Founder & Lead Stylist

Claire Vance

B.F.A. in Interior Design. Specializes in cozy living room space planning, warm minimalist bedrooms, and organic modern furniture curation.

Senior Bath & Architectural Editor

Marcus Sterling

12+ years in residential remodeling and millwork. Oversees our luxury bathroom tile guides, wood plank ceiling tutorials, and lighting layout standards.

Color, Textile & Seasonal Editor

Hannah Brooks

Specializes in boho bedroom layering, color theory, drapery hardware proportions, and warm holiday & seasonal home styling.

4. Editorial Independence & Advertising Disclosure

To keep all 234+ room guides and 4,000+ high-resolution interior photos 100% free for readers without paywalls or subscription fees, dreamhomedecor.net is supported by programmatic display advertising (including Google AdSense). Our editorial recommendations, paint color picks, and layout tips are written independently by our design team—brands cannot pay to alter our design critiques or styling tutorials. For full details, please read our Disclaimer and Privacy Policy.

5. Contact Our Studio

We love hearing from readers! Whether you want to share a room makeover, ask a layout question, or inquire about press and partnerships, reach our editorial desk anytime via our Contact Us page.

Effective Date: June 2026 · Summary: Dream Home Decor (dreamhomedecor.net) does not require user accounts, sell personal contact lists, or store financial data. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle standard browser logs, cookies, analytics, and Google AdSense advertising.

1. Information We Collect Automatically (Server & CDN Log Files)

Like all standard websites, dreamhomedecor.net uses standard web server and Content Delivery Network (CDN) log files. When you view a page or image, our hosting infrastructure automatically records non-identifying technical metadata, including:

  • Anonymized or truncated Internet Protocol (IP) address and general geographic region/country.
  • Browser type, operating system, screen resolution, and preferred language.
  • Date and time of each page request, referring/exit pages, and Core Web Vitals performance metrics.

This technical information is not linked to any personally identifiable information (PII) and is used strictly to maintain site security, prevent automated bot attacks, and optimize image delivery speeds.

2. Information You Voluntarily Provide

When you send us an inquiry through our Contact Us form, we collect your name, email address, and message content solely to reply to your question or process your request. We never sell, rent, or trade reader email addresses to third parties.

3. Google AdSense & DoubleClick DART Cookie Disclosure

We partner with third-party advertising networks, including Google AdSense (Publisher ID: ca-pub-4002444368603667), to serve advertisements when you visit dreamhomedecor.net:

  • Third-Party Vendors: Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to our website or other websites on the internet.
  • DoubleClick DART Cookie: Google's use of advertising cookies enables Google and its partners to serve personalized or contextual ads to our visitors based on their visit to dreamhomedecor.net and/or other sites on the Internet.
  • How to Opt Out of Personalized Advertising: Users may opt out of personalized advertising at any time by visiting Google Ads Settings or by visiting www.aboutads.info/choices. You can also manage your on-site consent toggles directly on our GDPR & CCPA Privacy Rights Center.

4. Analytics & UX Telemetry (Google Analytics 4 & Microsoft Clarity)

  • Google Analytics 4 (GA4 — G-MTS6C9QM0N): Measures aggregated page views, popular room categories, and reading engagement using first-party cookies with IP anonymization enabled.
  • Microsoft Clarity (x9ncd53tna): Captures anonymized scroll and click heatmaps so we can identify broken layout elements and improve mobile navigation. Personal input fields are masked automatically.

5. Data Processing & Retention Schedule

Data Category Purpose GDPR Legal Basis Retention Period

Consent Preference Key Storing your GDPR/CCPA cookie choices Legal Obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)) 12 Months in browser
Aggregated Analytics (GA4/Clarity) Measuring popular decor guides & UX Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)) 14 Months

6. Third-Party Links (Pinterest Share Buttons)

Our article images include a “📌 Save” button that opens Pinterest (`pinterest.com`) in a new browser tab if you choose to click it. No data is transmitted to Pinterest unless you actively click the Save button.

7. Children's Privacy (COPPA Compliance)

Dream Home Decor does not knowingly collect any personal information from children under the age of 13 (or under 16 in the EEA/UK). If you believe a child has submitted personal data via our contact form, please contact us via our Contact Us page so we can delete it immediately.

1. Your Rights Under the EU & UK GDPR (Articles 15–22)

If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA), the United Kingdom, or Switzerland, you have the following statutory rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR):

  • Right of Access (Art. 15) & Data Portability (Art. 20): Request confirmation of whether we hold any personal data about you and receive a copy in a structured format.
  • Right to Rectification (Art. 16) & Erasure / “Right to Be Forgotten” (Art. 17): Request correction or permanent deletion of any personal correspondence you have sent to us.
  • Right to Restriction (Art. 18) & Right to Object (Art. 21): Object to processing based on legitimate interests or direct marketing.
  • Right to Withdraw Consent (Art. 7(3)): Withdraw cookie or ad personalization consent at any time using the interactive panel above.

2. Google Consent Mode v2 & IAB Europe TCF v2.2

For visitors from the EEA, UK, and Switzerland, our advertising implementation respects Google Consent Mode v2 and the IAB Europe Transparency & Consent Framework (TCF v2.2). When personalized ad consent is withheld, Google AdSense serves only non-personalized contextual advertisements.

3. California CCPA / CPRA & U.S. State Privacy Rights

Under the California Consumer Privacy Act as amended by the CPRA (Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.100 et seq.), Virginia CDPA, Colorado CPA, Connecticut CTDPA, and Texas TDPSA, U.S. residents have the right to:

  • Know & Access the categories of personal information collected over the past 12 months.
  • Request Deletion of any personal information submitted via our contact form.
  • Opt Out of “Sale” or “Sharing”: While we never sell personal information for monetary consideration, third-party advertising cookies may be classified as “sharing” for cross-context behavioral advertising. Clicking “Reject Optional / Do Not Sell or Share” above disables personalized ad sharing immediately. We also honor browser-level Global Privacy Control (GPC) signals.

4. How to Submit a Verified Data Subject Request (DSAR)

To submit a formal GDPR or CCPA request, visit our Contact Us page and select Privacy, GDPR or CCPA Request. We respond to all verified requests free of charge within 15–30 days.

Editorial & Safety Disclosure: Dream Home Decor (dreamhomedecor.net) is an independent interior design and home styling publication. Please review our renovation safety, color accuracy, and advertising disclosures below.

1. DIY, Electrical, Plumbing & Structural Safety Disclaimer

Several guides on dreamhomedecor.net discuss architectural enhancements such as wood plank ceilings, recessed lighting layouts, bathroom vanity remodels, fireplace mantels, and wall paneling. Please note:

  • Always consult a licensed electrician, plumber, or structural contractor and check local municipal building codes before altering wiring, load-bearing walls, ceiling joists, bathroom waterproofing, or gas/wood fireplaces.
  • When mounting heavy mirrors, floating shelves, or ceiling beams, always anchor directly into wall studs or ceiling joists using hardware rated for the load.

2. Paint Color, Lighting & Screen Calibration Variance

Digital screens (smartphones, tablets, laptops) and indoor lighting conditions (north vs. south window exposure, 2700K vs. 4000K LED bulbs) significantly alter how paint colors, wood stains, and fabric swatches appear. Always test physical paint sample boards and fabric swatches on your own walls at different times of day before purchasing full gallons or custom upholstery.

3. Advertising & Google AdSense Disclosure

dreamhomedecor.net displays programmatic advertisements through Google AdSense (ca-pub-4002444368603667) to fund our writers, studio photography, and high-speed cloud hosting so our content remains free to the public. Advertisements are clearly distinguishable from our editorial content.

4. External Links Disclaimer

Our articles may reference or link to external websites for consumer convenience. We do not control and are not responsible for the content, availability, or privacy practices of any third-party sites.
